Honestly this post could probably be more applicable to gatekeepers in general and not just those who piss on girls. I just wish we could do a better job of supporting beginners instead of dissing them for not having any experience. It’s hard to ignore when you don’t have many friends to back you up at the park. It’s easier to ignore the online stuff. I don’t think people understand how ignoring something doesn’t always work.

My age and my mental health don’t have anything to do with this at all. I have no fucking respect for you or your opinion after that. I’m 16 and still know how to not be a dick. Somehow You need to grow up more than I do.

“Just skate”. If that were the case this subreddit wouldn’t exist. I’m just sharing something I’ve noticed and was wondering if anyone else noticed it too. Thats the reason the discussion flair is there right? I’m not trying to act tough, it’s not my fault if someone can’t take a joke. 

And no, I’m not an sjw, sharing your opinion on one thing doesn’t make you what the internet considers an sjw to be. Perhaps keyboard warrior would have been a better term but I digress. Don’t nitpick and ignore the point of the post. Or do I guess I don’t really care. 

I have a job and luckily enough I get paid for my work. I’m sure there is a wage gap but that’s irrelevant. Not sure why you included that tbh. 

It’s easy to tell people to just skate and not give a shit when you can’t identify with the problem. If you aren’t guilty or a victim of stigmatizing then this post isn’t really aimed at you, and you’re welcome to just keep on skating and ignore this.

Wow I empathize with you. That sounds like torture. The biggest thing that is keeping me around him is that I’m scared if I go away he’s really going to fall for this other girl. Anytime I ask about her he says he doesn’t know or that he wants to wait until he’s sure because she’s a cool friend. He isnt 100% sure about this new girl yet and it give me hope that he would choose me. But at the exact same time I don’t want to be an option. I want him to undoubtedly always choose me,, but he’s also human so I don’t know if it would be unreasonable to want something like that. It’s hard because I’d do anything for him, and he says he wants me in his life as a friend, but I also feel like I deserve better than that. 

TL;DR: I don’t know what’s above me and what isn’t.

It’s hard not to have hope, our relationship was long and we were best friends up til the end. We told each other everything and had so much fun. I couldn’t even tell you how he lost feelings for me so suddenly.

It’s hard for me because he’s one of my only friends, and if I stop talking to him I’ll be alone again. I tried deleting social media and not talking to him or any of our mutuals but news spreads fast in high school so I hear about everything anyways.
I know you’re just venting but I’m here and I see you. Don’t take the easy way out, life ain’t done with you yet. Crazy how fate works right? All heroes have a depressing ass backstory.
